headline: Swedish Regulator Fines Northmill Bank and Serafim for Violations
summary: Sweden's financial supervisory authority Finansinspektionen fined Northmill Bank 20 million kronor and financing firm Serafim 10 million kronor following regulatory compliance probes.
why: Finansinspektionen supervises Nordic banking compliance. Sanctions on Swedish niche and digital banks highlight tighter supervisory scrutiny over credit and operational practices.

impacts.name: Swedish Niche Banking
impacts.why: Sanction fees imposed by FI penalise non-compliance and raise future compliance expenses.
